instruction: Update every italic word to use blue font color for easier distinction from standard black text.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

Practical feasibility: get_vm_file can extract modified document, get_rule returns rules dict, metric downloads reference file and compares correctly
